source_field_note: Only the Cowrie-observed TCP peer (src_ip) is used. Forwarded-for style fields are never trusted; SSH has no such header.
proxy_client_mapping_note: No integrity-protected relay->client mapping exists in this deployment; sessions from trusted proxies are unattributable.
protected_cidrs_note: 172.22.0.0/16 cowrie_cowrie_internal (Cowrie 172.22.0.1, relay 172.22.0.2); 172.21.0.0/16 cowrie_relay_frontend (relay 172.21.0.2, gateway 172.21.0.1); 172.19.0.0/16 cowrie_default (legacy network, still present).
internal_cidrs_note: Explicit, verified deployment networks. RFC 5737 documentation ranges used by the traffic generator as stand-in 'LAN' hosts are NOT internal networks and are deliberately excluded.
